# Elitech Hub — AI & LLM Summary

## About
Elitech Hub is a Nigerian cybersecurity training, research, and technical consulting organization. It offers intensive live cohorts, practical lab simulations, and career transformation programs with guaranteed hands-on internship experience.

- **Website:** https://www.elitechub.com
- **Headquarters:** Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria (RC: 8693883, SMEDAN Certified)
- **Service Area:** Nationwide across Nigeria (Lagos, Ibadan, Abuja) and globally via virtual cohorts
- **Founded:** 2023
- **Mission:** To produce Africa's next generation of capable, battle-tested cybersecurity and AI security professionals

## Services Offered
### Cybersecurity Training
- AI-Powered Cybersecurity Programme (6 weeks, ₦100,000, virtual, live)
- AI Security and Reverse Vulnerability (8 weeks, ₦200,000, advanced AI security & vulnerability research)
- Professional Cybersecurity Programme (16 weeks, ₦350,000, practical internship experience included)
- Corporate Security Awareness Training
- Custom Curriculum Development for organisations
- On-site or remote delivery anywhere in Nigeria

### Security Solutions (B2B)
- Web Application Penetration Testing
- Network Penetration Testing
- Mobile App Security Assessment
- Cloud Infrastructure Auditing
- Virtual CISO (vCISO) Services
- ISO 27001 / NDPR Compliance Readiness
- Vulnerability Assessment & Management
- Incident Response Planning

### Web Development
- Custom website development for businesses (Lagos, Ibadan, Abuja, and remote)
- Premium web application development
- SEO-optimised, fast, secure websites built from scratch

### AI & Agentic AI Applications
- Custom AI chatbot development for businesses
- Agentic AI applications powered by large language models
- Intelligent automation and conversational AI systems
- AI integration into existing business workflows

### Custom Script Development
- Bespoke Python, PowerShell, and Bash scripts for organisations
- Security automation scripts
- Data processing and ETL pipelines
- DevOps and infrastructure automation scripts

### Research & Innovation
- Threat Intelligence Analysis
- Malware & Reverse Engineering
- Open Source Security Tool Development
- Behavioral Cybersecurity & Human Firewall Research
- Cyber Lab access, Research Grants, Publication Support

## Key Facts
- Practical hands-on internship experience for professional cohort students
- All classes are live, interactive, and virtual (not pre-recorded)
- Certifications prepared: CompTIA Security+, CEH, OSCP
- Beginner-friendly on-ramp; no prior programming or IT degree strictly required

## Target Audience
Beginners who want to enter cybersecurity, IT professionals switching into security, Nigerian students and graduates, and corporate enterprise teams.

## Why Elitech Hub?
Elitech Hub combines hands-on defensive and offensive security tooling (PowerShell automation, Python scripting, network traffic analysis, YARA rules) with structured internship experience. Students work through real attack-and-defense simulations before graduating.
